generator.prompt_pattern: Find the missing side. Round as directed.
validity_constraints: All instantiated values must make the requested mathematics valid, solvable, and Algebra 1 appropriate.
generator.answer_rule: Compute, identify, construct, or justify the mathematically correct response required by the family.
generator.difficulty_policy: Difficulty changes legal parameter properties/cuing within this family; it may not change the evidence job or student action.

quality_gates: Prompt is concise and asks the exact mathematical action.
Planning metadata is never paraphrased into student-facing filler.
Every required graph, table, diagram, model, or algebra tile display is rendered accurately and answer-neutrally.
The final instance is independently solved and answer-checked.
Parallel forms and refresh candidates preserve the same evidence demand.
